title: The Exorcist
synopsis: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Bikini Machine
synopsis: Mad scientist Dr. Goldfoot has invented an army of bikini-clad robots programmed to seek out wealthy men and charm them into signing over their assets. Secret agent Craig Gamble and millionaire Todd Armstrong set out to foil his fiendish plot.
